hypotheses.basis: The policy imposes a mandatory condition: the state where all passengers fly the same flights in the same cabin must hold. Violation occurs when this state is not satisfied.
unresolved_terms: same flights (whether this means identical flight numbers or equivalent itineraries)
same cabin (whether this means cabin class or specific seat type)
scope of 'all passengers' (per booking, per group, per flight)

hypotheses.basis: The obligation 'All passengers must fly the same flights in the same cabin' may only apply under a boundary condition (e.g., when there are multiple passengers). If boundary_2 represents the precondition that multiple passengers exist, then when boundary_2 is false (single passenger or no passengers), no obligation is triggered and no violation can occur. This changes the scope of when violations are assessed compared to the unconditional reading.
